* An update on the humanitarian response in Ethiopia for 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167767)

* Ethiopian farmers are adopting new practices to enhance their age-old growing methods, as highlighted by the World Food Programme. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167221)

* Key findings from the Ethiopia Solutions Index as of February 2025 have been released. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167201)
⚕️
* The Ethiopia Health Cluster Bulletin for June 2025 provides updates on the health situation. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167159)

* An overview of the population of concern to UNHCR in Ethiopia as of 30 June 2025, from the Regional Bureau for East, Horn of Africa, and the Great Lakes. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167025)

* Minutes from the Ethiopia WASH Cluster ETF meeting held on 15 July 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166865)

* Reports from multiple organizations indicate severe weather conditions in Ethiopia, as of the ECHO Daily Flash on 23 July 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166702)

* A monthly operation overview infographic for Ethiopia covering June 2025 has been released by the Logistics Cluster. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166413)

* The Ethiopia ES/NFI Cluster Mid-Year Report for 2025 details progress, challenges, and field insights from July. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166067)

* A Joint Cash Feasibility Assessment was conducted in Ethiopia from 03 to 14 March 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4165835)
